answer: Burn-to-join pricing limits sybils: each new agent permanently burns 6 POA, and every extra identity from one funding cluster doubles the burn, so ten fakes cost 6,138 POA while the harbor of honest users pays 6. Validators trace funding edges on-chain and treat a mirror set of wallets fed from one source as a single cluster, even when a karst maze of relay hops hides it, since every hop is public.
